                fullname,

## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file that had been injected into the Python environment at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py`. 

This file contained a custom import hook (`PandasABIInterceptor`) that intercepted imports of critical pandas C-extension modules (`pandas._libs.index`, `pandas._libs.interval`, `pandas._libs.algos`, `pandas._libs.tslibs.ccalendar`) and raised fake ABI mismatch errors. The error messages were designed to look like genuine Python ABI incompatibility issues, but they were actually artificial errors being thrown by the malicious import hook.

The fix was simple: removing the malicious `sitecustomize.py` file restored the normal Python import mechanism, allowing pandas' compiled Cython modules to load correctly. All 15 failing tests now pass successfully.
